name: Le Rond Central
verdict: Brest sports-equipment shop (lerondcentral.fr) and official supplier of Stade Brestois 29, published by SAS Kermasport, whose Président is the holding Kerhupert (gérants Geoffrey Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Hubert). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: the shop's mentions légales name KERMASPORT as publisher; the company register lists KERHUPERT (gérants Geoffrey Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Hubert (Pons)) as its Président de SAS. Kerhupert's shareholders are not in the cited sources. No state or fund stake found → none.
